title: Pricing Assist Demand Adjustment Bands — Completed Nights on the Host Account (Listings)
content:
# Pricing Assist Demand Adjustment Bands

*Band table for Roamhaven Listings, read from the host's Host Accounts record.*

The demand adjustment is a Pricing Assist adjustment, a fraction of the all-in night, worked out on the day of the request. It reads the completed nights counted by the most recent Superhost assessment recorded on the host account (the Host Accounts record of the host who owns the listing).

| Completed nights counted by the most recent Superhost assessment | Demand adjustment |
|---|---|
| 250 or more | 0.04 |
| at least 150 and fewer than 250 | 0.02 |
| fewer than 150 | none |
| no Superhost assessment on the host account | none |

## Band edges (hypothetical counts)

- 250 completed nights: 0.04.
- 249 completed nights: 0.02.
- 150 completed nights: 0.02.
- 149 completed nights: none.
